verdict.rationale: Numeral's marketing claims it registers across US and global jurisdictions and lists 'Autoregister' as a feature, and its MCP server exposes account registrations as callable tools, which suggests some in-product visibility. Per-registration pricing is not documented, since billing is described only per filing, and local-level registrations and registration status tracking are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, explicit local (sub-state) registration coverage, documented registration status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, registering for a sales tax permit is handled in-product — the vendor files state and local registrations on my behalf with transparent per-registration pricing and status tracking

citations.quote: Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
exposes your Numeral account — nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products, and exemption certificates — as tools an AI agent can call directly
